WATER_BASE_WATER_INITIATION.why: 'When you first gain the Water sphere, you gain Water Lash, Shape Current, and one Mortal Realm Water talent' -- a one-time build grant, not a fight action.

TAL_MAGMA_MAGMA_INITIATION.why: Choosing the cosmetic form your Magma takes (lava, slag, glass...) is a one-time build/flavor pick with no independent fight effect unless another feature says otherwise.

TAL_YIN_YIN_SAVES.why: 'Your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC' -- a rules-term definition with no combat effect of its own.

TAL_YIN_PRESERVE_THE_UNFINISHED_STATE.why: Preserves evidence, wounds, or spiritual imprints for later study; the text itself says it 'does not keep a living creature alive, prevent damage, restrain a target, or stop a hostile effect from functioning' -- no fight-state change.

TAL_WAX_EFFIGY_OF_THE_ABSENT.why: A 1-hour Rite with a 7-day duration (message/recognition/funeral vessel) -- prepared well outside a fight's timescale.

tianxia.talent.ash.read_the_ruins.why: A 10-minute Ritual Procedure that reads ash/soot for information; a GM answers questions, no fight-state effect.

TAL_YIN_MOONLIT_PRESERVATION.why: A 10-minute Ritual with a 24-hour (or longer) duration that preserves an object from decay -- outside a fight's timescale.

TAL_EARTH_BURIED_FOUNDATION_REMEMBERS.why: Recognizing whether a creature entered the same space in the last 24 hours needs memory the table does not track across that timescale; the 10-minute ground-reading half is also outside a single encounter.

TAL_EARTH_BURIED_TRACE.why: 1 minute of touching ground to erase/preserve tracks for future Survival/Investigation checks -- prep work between fights, not a fight action.

TAL_EARTH_PATIENT_ROADMAKER.why: 'When you spend at least 1 minute using Earth cultivation outside combat' -- explicitly an out-of-combat feature.

EARTH_BASE_SPENDING_A_BURDEN_MARK.why: Names five Earth Responses (Anchor Step, Drag Down, Bear the Blow, Shift the Load, Raise the Ridge) spent off a Burden Mark a THIRD PARTY triggers. Only Burden the Blade (a separate talent, same shape) is automated so far (combat/ext/elements_earth.py's attack_resolved hook). The other four need hooks this task does not have: Anchor Step/Drag Down trigger on a marked creature merely BEGINNING or WILLINGLY MAKING movement (no 'movement declared' hook exists, only 'enter a zone' and 'turn start/end'); Raise the Ridge triggers on a marked creature's ranged attack/spell/technique before the roll (no pre-attack-declared hook for a third party exists either); Bear the Blow needs to reduce damage from a third party's hit before it commits, which only the reaction-block pipeline can do today and that pipeline is keyed to the REACTOR's own economy, not a free once-per-round trigger off someone else's hit. Left GM-run rather than mistyped.

TAL_EARTH_SINKING_FOOT_REBUKE.why: Triggers when you spend a Burden Mark with Anchor Step or Drag Down; neither of those Earth Responses is automated yet (see EARTH_BASE_SPENDING_A_BURDEN_MARK), so this one never has a live trigger to key off.

TAL_EARTH_MOUNTAIN_ROOT_BODY.why: Counting your own body as three Foundation Spaces and serving as a legal origin point for other Earth features depend on the Foundation-Space/origin-legality bookkeeping the table does not model at that granularity yet; Resistance to falling/crushing damage has no matching damage source in the table's fights either. (The Dodge-triggered Burden Mark is automated: combat/ext/lane4_earth.py, feature_blocks.d/auto_lane4.json.)

GLASS_BASE_REFRACTION_RESPONSES.why: Six named Refraction Responses, each keyed off a different third-party trigger (a marked creature hitting you/an ally before damage commits; attempting to Hide/turn Invisible/use Cover; willingly moving 5+ feet; attacking through your Glass Surface; you spending a mark near a creature; a marked object taking damage). None of these triggers exist as a plug-in hook yet for a THIRD PARTY's action (only your own attacks/saves/turns are hooked), and 'Glass Surface' is not tracked as a placed, targetable object. See the reviewed_final.d/elements.json rider on this record for the exact per-response detail.

TAL_LIGHTNING_OVERLOAD_WARD.why: Targets 'One visible ward, barrier, talisman effect, qi shield, formation node, or Construct-like temporary qi effect' and rolls a Lightning Check against a DC the GM sets ad hoc; the table has no generic non-creature ward/formation object with its own DC to target or suppress.

TAL_LIGHTNING_FORMATION_SPLITTING_BOLT.why: Same gap as Overload Ward: targets a formation node/construct/ward anchor, not a creature, and reduces 'one of its numerical effects' -- nothing the table tracks.

TAL_LIGHTNING_FORMATION_EXTINGUISHING_ED.why: Same formation/ward/talisman-anchor targeting gap as Formation-Splitting Bolt; only the Success-by-5-or-More Arc damage to connected creatures is a real creature-facing effect and is typed.

TAL_LIGHTNING_TALISMAN_BURNOUT.why: Triggers when a creature 'activates a talisman, stored-command technique, scroll, charm, seal, or comparable prepared qi medium' -- the table does not track talisman/scroll activation as a distinct event to react to.

TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDERHEAD_LATTICE.why: A 10-minute out-of-combat warding utility around a chest/altar/formation component; the disarm/damage-on-tamper clause has no matching object to attach to in a fight.

TAL_EARTH_THE_GROUND_KEEPS_SCORE.why: Moves your Burden Mark to a new creature 'that contributed to the same hostile action, such as by granting advantage, maintaining the effect, commanding the attacker, or standing inside the same hostile formation' -- after_miss/after_save hooks exist to see the triggering failure, but picking a legal new bearer needs GM judgment about who counted as contributing, not a mechanical check.

TAL_EARTH_MULE_SHOULDER_METHOD.why: The Exhaustion-delay clause needs the table's Exhaustion-from-strain tracking (forced marching/carrying/digging hours), which fights do not run on; the once-per-short-rest 'ignore a Burden Mark/Grappled/Prone from an Earth, Stone, Force, or similar weight-based effect' clause has no generic 'ignore the next qualifying condition' hook yet.

GLASS_BASE_TEMPER_GLASS_SURFACE.why: Its only mechanical role is naming which surface anchors your Faultline Marks/Refraction Responses and how many you may maintain at once; Faultline-Mark-granting talents (Faultline Strike, Glass Shard, Glass-Bone Guard) already work without a separate 'is a Glass Surface tempered' check, so using it changes narration, not fight state.
